title: Computer Vision Engineer
summary: Computer vision engineers build models that understand images and video, such as spotting defects, reading number plates or counting people. They sit in an AI or product team and take a model from labelled data to something that runs on servers or small edge devices (cameras and boards on site).
dailyDuties: Prepare and check labelled image datasets
Train and fine-tune detection or segmentation models
Pre-process images and video with OpenCV
Measure models with mAP, precision and recall
Speed up models for edge devices or GPUs
Ship inference code to the product team

skills.expectation: Write training and inference code in Python
Train detection, segmentation or classification models on images and video
Pre-process images and video with OpenCV
Understand CNNs and modern vision architectures
Train and fine-tune vision models in PyTorch
Measure models with mAP, IoU, precision and recall
Keep code and experiments in Git
Speed up models with ONNX, TensorRT or quantization for edge devices
Write fast inference code in C++
Run annotation in CVAT or Label Studio and check label quality
Train or host models on a cloud GPU

certifications.why: Training and deploying models on AWS
Training and deploying models on Google Cloud
